items.item:
3. A backup cannot be read without the key it was made with.
   Shows A18-2. [witness: verification:registry_a18_backup_unreadable_without_its_key]
statements:
```text
after a run whose deletions succeeded: no kept backup whose instant is
earlier than its third step's cutoff (that step's start less
30 × 24 hours) exists   -- A18-1
after a run whose deletions succeeded: no backup that failed its check
exists, kept or temporary   -- A18-3
every backup, when it becomes kept, is encrypted, consistent, checked, and
records (instant, release, last sequence); no backup holds an agent
session   -- A18-2
```

assert b"SQLite format 3" not in raw
assert b"Casa Encriptada" not in raw
raise AssertionError("a backup was read with the key of an older one")
verdicts.why: The selected test detects reading with the wrong key and checks ciphertext does not expose the database header, a stored value, or the key, so it asserts the encryption/key portion of A18-2. It does not assert consistency, successful checking before keeping, the instant/release/last-sequence record fields, exclusion of agent sessions, retention under A18-1, or deletion of failed backups under A18-3.
